landingPage.title: Landing Page

starterBusiness.title: Starter Business
starterBusiness.description: Four pages (home, about, services, contact) with a menu and a footer. Teal.

appointments.title: Appointments
appointments.description: One page for a salon or a practice: services with times and prices, the team, hours, a button to book. Green.

foodAndDrink.title: Food and drink
foodAndDrink.description: Phone first: a home page and a menu with prices, the hours, the address, buttons to call or order. Red.

trades.title: Trades and home services
trades.description: Home and quote pages: services, the area served, why trust you, a button to ask for a quote. Navy and amber.

professional.title: Professional office
professional.description: For an accountant, a lawyer or an adviser: areas of practice, the team, how a first meeting goes, a button to book one. Burgundy.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.description: Your work first: a grid of pieces with their captions, an about page, a button to write to you. Black and white.

stay.title: Stay
stay.description: For a B&B or a holiday rental: the rooms with their prices, breakfast, what is nearby, a button to check availability. Blue and sand.

event.title: Event
event.description: One page for a conference, a festival or an open day: the date and the place, the programme, the speakers, tickets by a link. Yellow and black.

club.title: Club or association
club.description: For a sports club or an association: the week's sessions, the dates to come, the committee, how to join. Green and orange.

personal.title: Personal page
personal.description: Phone first: one page with your photo, a line about you and your links as large buttons. Pink.

shop.title: Shop window
shop.description: For a shop: the new arrivals with their prices, the shelves, the hours, buttons to order or call. Terracotta.

aiPictures.label: Let the AI bring its own pictures
aiPictures.help: The AI gives each picture's link; QuickSite downloads it into Media and puts it in place. A picture that could not be downloaded stays an address outside the site, listed at the end of the run.

coloursOnly.label: Colours only
coloursOnly.help: Sends the site's CSS variables instead of its whole stylesheet: a much shorter prompt, but the AI cannot see the corners, shadows and buttons to match.

darkMode.label: Include dark mode
darkMode.help: Adds a light/dark button, which the AI places where it fits, and the dark colours it writes. Dark mode is switched on once its commands have run.

includeAssets.label: Include my starred assets in the prompt
includeAssets.help: The AI will use your starred assets (images, fonts, etc.) instead of placeholders. Star them on the Media page first.

includeFavicon.label: Include favicon documentation
includeFavicon.help: The AI will also receive editFavicon command docs and may set a favicon from your assets.

keepAssets.label: Keep existing assets during fresh start
keepAssets.help: Preserve your uploaded assets (images, fonts, etc.) when the project is reset before creation.

createWebsite.title: Create Website: one AI request
createWebsite.description: Generate a complete website in one AI request: several pages with navigation, or one page whose menu links to its sections, with a shared header and footer, the texts of every language and consistent styling.

onePage.label: One page only
onePage.help: Builds the home page only, its menu linking to the page's sections: a landing page.

createWebsiteSteps.title: Create Website: several AI requests
createWebsiteSteps.description: Builds the site in several AI requests: the pages and their texts in the default language, then each other language, then the look. A cut answer costs only its own part.

fitCookieBanner.title: Fit my cookie banner
fitCookieBanner.description: Gives the cookie banner and its popup your site's look. Generate the banner first, on the Compliance page.

fitConsentPages.title: Fit my consent pages
fitConsentPages.description: Gives the cookie policy and privacy pages your site's look. Generate them first, on the Compliance page.

from.label: Translate from

restyle.title: Restyle Website

runBatch.title: Run Command Batch
runBatch.description: Paste and execute a JSON command batch directly — no prompt generation needed.

phone.label: Phone number
phone.help: Shown on the site, and called by its Call buttons. Digits, spaces and a leading + only. Left empty, the template's sample number.

email.label: E-mail address
email.help: Shown on the site, and written to by its e-mail links. Left empty, the template's sample address.

address.label: Address
address.help: The street address shown on the site, on one line. Left empty, the template's sample address.

bookingUrl.label: Booking or ordering link
bookingUrl.help: Where the template's main button leads (book, order, join): the page of the service you use, starting with https://. Left empty, a sample link.

buildQuicksite.title: Build QuickSite
buildQuicksite.description: Rebuilds the full QuickSite website from scratch: languages, routes, page structures, translations, styles, and favicon. Uses fresh-start as pre-workflow and update-lang-switch as post-workflow.

keyframesPresets.title: Keyframe Animation Presets

freshStart.title: Fresh Start

keepAssets.label: Keep Assets

keepLanguages.label: Keep Languages

draft.title: Draft from one test response, not saved. Review it, then press Save.

draft.mixed: A different type between elements, all listed. Response Mapping does not look inside these:
draft.map: Keyed by what look like ids, addresses or tokens, or by more than {fields} names. Those names are data, so they are not written, and the draft describes their values instead:
draft.unsafe: Left out, because a field by this name cannot be read back by the page (it names part of a JavaScript object):
draft.sampled: A long list, of which the first {items} elements were read:
draft.deep: Read to {depth} levels. What lies below was not read:
